items.note: S2.4.1 states the eight-row schedule, the update y_S <- y_S + x_S for arbitrary scratch values and the three-stage exchange (X_a,Y_a)->(-Y_a,X_a) restoring every scratch wire (728-739). It omits h=100, the triple indexing, the neighbour rules and the wire counts, and gives no derivation of the net change (JV+RG)x or of the stage composition (741-765).

Follows the paper's invariant argument: a common frame commutes with a pointwise gate, so the network implements D_out S_Omega D_in^{-1} and intermediate frames are free (804-825). The route operator omits the scalar sign epsilon_w (820-822), and the S2.4.2 claim drops S_Omega.

Gives the right statements: neighbouring triple lines are orthogonal, the only decreasing edges are the central wires from time 3 to 4 losing h, L=Ich, the budget Wm-2N+2L, and L/N=100/539 and 101/539. The derivation is thin: there are no terminal labels, no stage transition or gate-label table (881-988), and no telescoping argument (source dims N, sink dims Wm-N; 1066-1071).

States s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b<W_b m and the endpoint identity I_m, and derives the rank sum faithfully: rank(P_V-P_U)=dim V-dim U, plus N rank-one source exceptions (1158-1167). The endpoint computation P_{U_a^perp}-(-P_{U_a})=I_m (1169-1171) and the shear frames Phi_M (1124-1136) are missing.

S2.4.3.5 correctly states one kernel aI+bX_v per orthonormal residual vector and s_c=W_c m-2N+2L_c<W_c m. It never defines the phase frames C_U (1193), and it does not state that after the diagonal corrections every role receives C^{tensor m} (1225-1228). The proof (1231-1315) is not followed.

The chain L/N<1/2, then deficit N-2L>0, then relative deficits >20*2^{-50} with log m<20, gives s/W<m^tau with tau=sigma=1-2^{-50}, as in 1105-1110 and 1331-1344. The exact eta values are not quoted, but the route is the paper's.

Both lemmas are stated, and S2.3 names the split-at-offset-and-merge mechanism (577-580). The S2.3 claim drops the b^{O(1)} offset-preparation condition (present only in the quote) and the multiplication by fixed rational units (569-570). No derivation is given.

A=E_1 Pi E_2, triangular factors handled as controlled shifts, and each one of Pi done by D_j+=H_i, swap, D_j=H_i-D_j, which follows 1425-1443. The fixed prime q and the arithmetic over Z/q^b are missing from the statement, and the pivot-elimination proof of the factorization (1375-1392) is absent.

Gives the row split into W streams of volume V/W, the three shears, exactly s calls, F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1), the geometric sum and the O(V) parking cost, all as in 1497-1588. It omits the row-field divisibility by W^k and the radix q. It also never shows how the shear frames Phi_M and the endpoint identity give H<-H+D on every row (1514-1533).

Follows the proof: the top rho digits form the row field at cost O(V rho), rows are padded to a multiple of W^k, the remaining width is expanded in base m and handled by the power-width procedure, and [2^u] is padded to [q^e] (1650-1734).

Gives the C identities, the GL(m,F_2) change of basis P_M putting residual directions in slots, exactly s_c children on e/m axes, inverse children via (-i)^f Z C Z, and H_0^{tensor D}=b^D S_D C^{tensor D} S_D, matching 1827-1930. The decomposition into a fixed number of row additions appears implicitly through S2.6.2.

Gives the eight operations restoring w and flipping the parity of u, the bad set with |B|<=delta_bad M, and repair by extraction and stable radix sort, with the exact time bound (2001-2005, 2016-2185).

Gives rows from the first q_0 chunks, the split u=Wg+w giving child volume V/W, F(e)<=(s/W)F(e/m)+O((eK)^tau+1) with leaves O(e), internal O(e^lambda), leaves O(e^sigma d^{beta(1-sigma)}) and the base-m pieces giving O(d^{lambda'}), as in 2306-2445.

Correctly states Q_p(Hz) in O(Vd^{lambda'}) with error <sqrt2 2^{-p} and exact evaluation with guard width ceil(C_0 d^{C_1})=o(p). The guard-width derivation (arithmetic depth A(e)<=sA(e/m)+E, 2475-2560) is not reproduced; it is only asserted.

Character cancellation, the DIF step, bit-reversed storage, the reverse procedure giving F^+B^{-1} and round grouping all follow 2810-2915. The layout and cost step S3.2 is only an inference. It does not show how L places selected bits at a common chunk offset (2990-3028), and it gives no error accumulation argument.
Evaluation at B_0=2^{4p}, four integer products, the separation bound |h_j|<=r2^{2p}<2^{3p}<B_0/2, centered-residue extraction with carry in {0,1}, and negacyclic reduction, all as in 3233-3368.

Gives the commuting of the record permutation with pointwise products and the normalization identity F^-(f*g)=M(F^-f)(F^-g) with F^+F^-=I/M (3422-3439). The final exact scaling by M appears only as 'scaled', and the error bound 3delta+eta (3441-3474) is asserted, not derived.

P_sF_s=2^{2alpha^2}B_0P_tF_tA under theta>p/alpha^4, the approximation error and cost, the tensor form with gamma=2d alpha^2, and the axis-exposure cost are all stated correctly. P_s and P_t are never defined ((P_su)_j=u_{tj}, (P_tv)_k=v_{-sk}), and the Gaussian construction of A and B_0 (3576-3792) is not shown.
Both identities are stated correctly, with the chirp a_j=exp(-pi i sum s_i j_i^2/t_i). There is no derivation, and conjugation for RF^+ is not stated.

Sizes, the prime interval with more than d primes, T/2<S<T and alpha^4 theta_i>p follow 4055-4148. The fixed choice omits delta=1/16, C_1 and kappa. eta=1/(4d) and alpha=ceil((12d^2b)^{1/4}) are never given, so alpha^4 theta_i>p is asserted, not derived (4089-4146).

Phi is an isomorphism because the image of x has order S, the triangular coordinates are b_i=a_i+mu_i sum_{j<i}a_jP_j, it is implemented by controlled shifts and O(d^2) axis moves, and the cost is O(Tpd^2(1+ell^tau)), all as in the paper.

The isometric isomorphism and the wrap check zeta^{k+l}(-1)^h=zeta^j follow 4303-4319. The resulting identity M_C(f,g)=D_- iota^{-1} M_r(iota D_+f, iota D_+g)=(f*g)/T (4338-4341) and the computed-twist error analysis (4349-4413) are absent.
The source transform F=2^gamma B_0 Q F_t A=RF_s and the six steps with the two scalings by S and by 2^{2b+4}S are correct. The explanation of why S occurs twice matches 4536-4541.

The disk margins (.26), E_w=S(3E_s+2)<28 2^gamma T^2 L, and the final error <448b 2^{-b+gamma}<=448b 2^{-3b/4}<1/2 are correct. The upstream chain (E_ring, chirp error, E_s=9 2^gamma TL) and the use of gamma<=b/4 are not shown.

All seven table rows and their powers, the minimum margin g_2=epsilon c(1-tau)=2^{-181}=2kappa, and the final O(Tp p^{1-kappa}) bound match the paper. The o(V) setup and the schoolbook cutoff are not mentioned.
S1 recalls the n log n order and the HvdH bound, but no step says the bound refutes an eventual c_A n lg n lower bound (liminf zero; 379-387). The plan only alludes to the conjecture.

errors.says: The array network applies only the endpoint operator D_out D_in^{-1} to each role (and S2.4.2.2: a route applies D_sink(rho(w)) D_source(w)^{-1}).
errors.paper: The implemented operator is D_out S_Omega D_in^{-1}; a route applies epsilon_w D_sink(rho(w)) D_source(w)^{-1}, with the scalar sign epsilon_w (e.g. -1 on Y_a -> X_a in the complex network).

errors.says: Gather and scatter coefficients depend on the intersection size and side wires cancel the unwanted ones, quoting the label inner product at line 864.
errors.paper: The coefficient and cancellation facts belong to the scalar-network proof (central coefficient |S cap T| mod 2 or (|S cap T|-1)/2, side wires cancel); the quoted line 864 concerns the bilinear form on labels, not gate coefficients.

errors.says: Each edge of the complex network factors into one two-point kernel C=aI+bX per residual basis vector.
errors.paper: Each factor is the translation kernel aI+bX_v along the residual vector v, not the coordinate kernel C=aI+bX; it becomes C on a coordinate slot only after conjugation by P_M.

chain: The tree follows the paper's route to the main bound: a fixed exchange network with restored scratch wires, common frames, nested labels with L<N/2 giving s<Wm, matrix shears costing one call per unit of rank, and the recurrence F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1) giving O(e^tau). From there it runs through the chunk interchange and the simultaneous layer, the synthetic transform and convolution, resampling and the chirp, the algorithm, exact recovery and the cost table with min g_i=2kappa. It thins at the link from the endpoint identity to the shear H<-H+D (the shear frames Phi_M are never defined), at the label construction (no transition or gate-label table), at the complex phase frames, and at the resampling, guard-width and error chains, which are stated rather than derived.

steps.note: Carries the eight-row copy/gather/scatter/side-injection network that exchanges (X_a,Y_a)->(-Y_a,X_a) and restores every scratch wire, with triples appearing in S2.4.3.1. h=100, N=binom(h,3)^3 and m=h^3 are never given numerically, so the reconstruction is thin on sizes.
A common frame commutes with a pointwise gate, the operator D_out S_Omega D_in^{-1}, and the edges pay only D_vD_u^{-1}, all as in the paper (sign epsilon_w omitted).
Nondegenerate subspaces of F^{tensor 3}, comparable labels on every edge, and the only decreasing edges being central 3->4 each losing h are all present. The explicit label table is not given.
rank(P_V-P_U)=dim V-dim U, and the N negative source projections are the rank-one exceptions.
Gives the sum of |Delta dim| = Wm-2N+2L with L=Ich, and s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b.
Gives L_b/N=100/539 and L_c/N=101/539, both below 1/2, and the deficit N-2L_b>0, so s<Wm.

The identity (endpoint matrices differ by I_m on every input role) is stated, and S2.4.6.2 has the network perform the middle shear H<-H+D. The shear frames Phi_M that turn the identity into that shear are not defined, so the mechanism is only implicit.
A=E_1 Pi E_2, exactly a interchanges plus O(V), and s recursive calls per node in total.
Gives children of volume V/W, F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1), tau=1-2^{-50} from deficits >20*2^{-50} and log m<20, and F_k=O(e^tau).

central.summary: P02 reconstructs all nine steps of the central saving in order: the exchange network, frames, nested labels, rank equal to dimension change with N source exceptions, the budget, L/N<1/2 giving s<Wm, the endpoint identity, edges as recursive calls, and the recurrence with tau=1-2^{-50}. The weak points are the missing numerical sizes (h=100, N), the missing label table, and the undefined shear frames Phi_M, which leave the link from the endpoint identity to H<-H+D implicit.
